title: Understanding Stochastic Gradient Descent
text: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) updates the parameters for each training example, which can cause the updates to fluctuate around the optimal solution.

title: Characteristics of SGD
text: SGD is known for its high variance in updates, which can lead to oscillations around the minimum.
